title: France Study Visa Pakistan — Requirements, Fees & Process | SK Immigration
description: France study visa from Pakistan: requirements, documents, fees, timeline, common mistakes and FAQ. Honest guidance by SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: What are the main requirements for a France study visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Typically admission/offer documents, proof of funds, passport, academic records, and any language or medical checks France requires. Exact lists change — SK Immigration builds a country checklist for your case.

faqs.question: How long does a France student visa take from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Often 3–6 months including Campus France steps where required Peak intakes and incomplete files take longer.

faqs.question: What are typical fees for France study visa Pakistan applicants?
faqs.answer: Campus France / visa fees + living proof; SK packages from PKR 50,000. Official fees are paid to universities/missions; our service fee covers preparation only.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee the visa?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and immigration authorities decide every application. We prepare honest, complete files and explain risks clearly.

faqs.question: Can SK Immigration help with attestation for France?
faqs.answer: Yes — we sequence Apostille/MOFA/embassy steps when your destination requires legalized Pakistani documents.

faqs.question: Is IELTS always required?
faqs.answer: Not always. Some programs accept MOI letters, university tests or other evidence. We map realistic language pathways case by case.

France study from Pakistan — Campus France logic

France is attractive for public-university tuition structures and English-taught master’s options, but Pakistani applicants usually need to respect Campus France / Études en France procedures (where applicable) before a long-stay student visa file is strong. SK Immigration helps with sequencing; French authorities decide.

Who should consider France

  • Students with a coherent academic progression into a French programme
  • Applicants ready for portal interviews / procedures when required
  • Budgets that include living costs (Paris is materially higher than many other cities)

Language reality

French-taught programmes typically need French tests (e.g. TCF/TEF/DELF pathways — confirm current university rules). English-taught programmes may ask IELTS/TOEFL or equivalent. “No IELTS” marketing is meaningless without the programme’s written rule.

Process outline

  1. Programme shortlist + academic fit
  2. Campus France / university application steps for your intake
  3. Acceptance / registration evidence
  4. Funds, insurance, housing proofs as listed
  5. Visa appointment — complete file first

Mistakes to avoid

  • Ignoring Campus France when your case requires it
  • Underestimating living costs outside tuition
  • Weak ties between past studies and the chosen master’s
  • Paying unofficial “guaranteed visa” sellers
